title: A failed diagnostic write in a hinted causal pull drops the whole hinted batch
outcome: If note_ready_causal_pending (a diagnostics-only write) fails during take_causal_ready_plans, the hinted pull logs it and keeps the plan, or requeues the hints already taken from the ready queue, instead of ending read_ready_causal_test_completions and dropping those hints.
acceptance: A failed diagnostic write in a hinted causal pull drops the whole hinted batch is done
